summary: Iteration 23 backend tests PASS 27/27 (100%). Owner reply photo-attach feature works end-to-end: POST /api/responses/upload-photo requires auth (401), rejects empty (400) and >8MB (413), writes to '<app>/replies/<user_id>/<uuid>.<ext>' with jpg/jpeg/png/webp/heic whitelist + jpg fallback for unknown/missing filename. POST /api/responses/{id}/reply accepts optional photos:List[str] (max 4), returns 422 on 5+ photos and on empty message, round-trips the photos array back on the outbound ReportResponse, and sends email without crashing even when storage can't fetch (fake paths test). ReportResponse.photos default [] applies to legacy inbound docs (list + thread endpoints both expose it). Regressions for iterations 20/21/22 (drafts, public respond, portal HTML, project summary PATCH, mail schedule GET/PUT, read/unread/archive/delete, outbound-excluded default list) all green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py @ /responses/upload-photo (lines ~2696-2718): clean + size-guarded + extension-whitelisted. Good: object-storage write wrapped in run_in_threadpool, uuid4() filenames avoid collisions, 502 raised on storage failure. Minor nit (not blocking): no explicit MIME-sniff — relies on client-provided Content-Type; acceptable since filename extension is the authority for the stored key.
server.py @ OwnerReply (line 2693): photos: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=4) correctly produces a 422 for 5+ items via Pydantic — verified.

server.py @ reply_to_response (line 2733): fetches each photo via _get_object inside run_in_threadpool and silently skips failures when inlining — correct resilience; DB write still succeeds so the thread view remains source of truth. Verified with 4-fake-paths test (200 OK, email_delivered bool returned).
server.py @ ReportResponse (line 254-275): photos: List[str] = [] with default — legacy inbound docs lacking the field deserialize to [] (confirmed by list + thread tests).
server.py is 3343 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Not a blocker for this feature, but a future refactor target (split responses, digest, reports, projects into submodules).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration23_reply_photos.py (fixed 2 regression-test assertions that didn't match actual API shape: draft/today may return null when no draft exists; PUT /digest/mail-schedule returns {ok, schedule:{...}} wrapper; also added single ReadTimeout retry on the parametrized upload test to tame preview-tunnel flakiness)
seed_data_creation: Each test creates its own report+inbound-reply via autouse _wipe_between_tests fixture that deletes all responses after each test. No persistent seed data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 23 reply-photo feature is production-ready. The only flakiness observed was a single ReadTimeout on multipart uploads via the preview tunnel (now mitigated with one retry in the parametrized whitelist test). If future iterations touch /responses/upload-photo or ReportResponse.photos, re-run test_iteration23_reply_photos.py — all 27 cases should remain green. No frontend testing was performed (explicit backend-only request); when the Mail-tab photo picker UI is ready, test the full upload→preview→send→email round-trip from the Expo client.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no backend bugs found. Two initial test failures were test-assertion mismatches (not backend defects) corrected in the test file: (1) draft/today legitimately returns JSON null when no draft exists for today; (2) PUT /digest/mail-schedule returns {ok, schedule} wrapper rather than the raw schedule doc.
